answer.summary: E2E failed because the app container crashed at startup with a duplicate Flyway migration version: V6_20261118120000000 is used by both this PR's new migration (V6_20261118120000000__Catalog_connector_injector_contracts.java) and an existing one (Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side). This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run, so the migration version must be renamed.
